IDs are Cursor model IDs as returned by `python3 scripts/uc_review_runner.py models`; confirm them there before a run, because the SDK's model list differs per account. `params` are model parameter id/value pairs (for example reasoning effort). Rationale: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-26-uc-text-quality-review.md, section 'Recommended models'.
